cli_checks.case: option-shaped commit ID rejected before screen

cli_check_script:
import json, os, subprocess, tempfile, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("suite", "rust/tests/upstream-suite.py")
suite = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(suite)
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
fixture = (root / 'test/main/escape-control-characters-test.in').read_bytes().split(b'\n')[0]
results = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='tig-raw-') as tmp:
    directory = Path(tmp)
    steps = directory / 'steps'
    screen = directory / 'screen'
    config = directory / 'tigrc'
    config.write_text('set main-view = commit-title:yes,graph=no,refs=no\n')
    steps.write_text(f':save-display {screen}\n:quit\n')
    env = {k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('TIG', 'GIT_', 'XDG_'))}
    env.update(TIGRC_SYSTEM='', TIGRC_USER=str(config), TIG_SCRIPT=str(steps), LC_ALL='C', TZ='UTC', COLUMNS='100', LINES='5')
    for mode, binary in [('c',root/'src/tig'), ('rust',root/'target/release/tig')]:
        data = fixture.replace(b'correctly v2', b'\x1b[2J\x07\r\tend') + b'\n'
        raw = directory / 'raw'
        raw.write_bytes(data)
        code, timeout, transcript = suite.terminal(['sh', '-c', 'exec "$1" --pretty=raw < "$2"', 'sh', str(binary), str(raw)],env,15)
        assert code == 0 and not timeout, (mode,transcript)
        row = screen.read_bytes().split(b'\n')[0].rstrip()
        assert row == b'Check GBM_BO_USE_LINEAR  [2J   end', (mode,row)
        assert not any(c < 32 or c == 127 for c in row), row
        results.append(dict(mode=mode,case='control rendering',exit_code=code,row=row.decode()))
        screen.unlink()
    data = fixture.replace(b'7363156', b'--output=/tmp/tig-injected') + b'\n'
    p = subprocess.run([str(root/'target/release/tig'),'--pretty=raw'],input=data,capture_output=True,cwd=tmp,env=env,timeout=15)
    assert p.returncode != 0 and b'Invalid raw commit ID' in p.stderr and not screen.exists(), p
    results.append(dict(mode='rust',case='option-shaped commit ID rejected before screen',exit_code=p.returncode,stderr=p.stderr.decode()))
Path('../work/raw-cli.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print('PASS: C/Rust control rendering; Rust malicious ID rejection')
